test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 07 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of these may NOT be attributed to micro-finance?

options.text: Financial services could enable the poor to leverage their entrepreneurial initiatives.
Financial services could enable the poor to accelerate the process of building assets and economic security.
Financial services could enable the poor to accelerate the process of building incomes.
Financial services could enable the poor to earn high rates of interest on deposits.

solution:
The correct answer is __**Financial services could enable the poor to earn high rates of interest on deposits.**__
